entries.description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
formatErrors: Skill references must stay within one level

entries.name: api-spec
entries.description: Define or update the authoritative OpenAPI contract and run API validation selected by an OpenSpec quality plan. Use when HTTP API impact is declared.

entries.name: auth-check
entries.description: Review authentication and authorization changes against OpenSpec requirements and trust boundaries. Use when the quality plan selects auth review.

entries.name: change-retrospective
entries.description: Produce the typed post-Satisfaction Review retrospective for a spec-led-v2 mutation change. Use to record evidence-backed findings, amendments, repairs, candidates, or an explicit no-finding result.

entries.name: check-selection
entries.description: Create or revise the complete catalog-pinned Check Selection for a spec-led-v2 mutation change. Use after proposal, delta specs, design, and impact are approved and before Selection Review.

entries.name: code-review
entries.description: Perform the final independent review required by an OpenSpec quality plan. Use after deterministic checks pass.

entries.name: dependency-survey
entries.description: Review dependency impact and current library choices for an OpenSpec change. Use when its quality plan selects dependency review.

entries.name: fallow-check
entries.description: Run Fallow checks selected by an OpenSpec quality plan and disposition changed-code findings. Use when Fallow impact is declared.

entries.name: mutation-testing
entries.description: Run mutation testing only when OpenSpec impact and quality-plan records contain direct human opt-in, bounded scope, budget, command, and threshold.

entries.name: observability-contract
entries.description: Define and review measurable Quality Attribute Scenarios, Product Observability, Workflow Telemetry, logging, profiling, and threshold follow-up for a spec-led-v2 change.

entries.name: satisfaction-review
entries.description: Independently judge whether fresh evidence and the task-owned diff satisfy a spec-led-v2 Check Selection and approved intent. Use after deterministic implementation checks.

entries.name: security-scan
entries.description: Run the deterministic security commands selected by an OpenSpec quality plan and triage their findings. Use for SAST, secret, or dependency scanning.

entries.name: selection-review
entries.description: Independently review a spec-led-v2 Check Selection before quality-plan and task finalization. Use for the required fresh-context, non-author, read-only Selection Review.

entries.name: skill-governance
entries.description: Search the generated Skill Index and govern evidence-backed skill repair, placement, evaluation, approval, and installation proposals from a spec-led-v2 retrospective.

entries.name: spec-led-change
entries.description: Route OpenSpec change work to the installed propose, update, apply, or archive skill and run only the quality checks selected by the change. Use when starting, revising, implementing, or archiving an OpenSpec change.

entries.name: strict-maintainability-review
entries.description: Run a rigorous maintainability review of an OpenSpec change diff. Use when its quality plan selects maintainability review.

entries.name: tdd-enforcement
entries.description: Run red-green TDD for meaningful behavior selected by an OpenSpec quality plan, or verify its approved waiver. Use before implementation code changes.

entries.name: ui-evidence
entries.description: Capture visual and accessibility evidence selected by an OpenSpec quality plan. Use when UI impact is declared.
